rows.en: Amuro and the rest of Londo Bell
draw up a plan to blow Axis apart from within
and clash with Char's main force.
And the new mobile suit Amuro designed,
the "Nu Gundam,"
was about to be unveiled.
With his operation on track, Char
goes after the greatest obstacle left, Londo Bell,
launching to meet them head-on.
rows.note: shutsugeki + mukaeutsu = sortie to intercept; split across 1995/1996 to keep cut point

rows.en: It was also a chance to face his longtime rival,
Amuro, and settle things once and for all.
Universal Century 0079.
The Principality of Zeon challenged the Earth Federation Forces
rows.note: jionkoukokugun rendered 'Principality of Zeon' (not '...Forces') to keep width; if too wide: 'Zeon challenged the Earth Federation Forces'

rows.en: in a war of independence, and with the front in deadlock,
more than eight months had passed.
Major Char Aznable of the Zeon forces,
learning that in the space colony Side 7
the Federation Forces are developing a new weapon,
launches a surprise attack on it.
But a civilian boy caught in the evacuation,
Amuro Ray, happens upon the Earth Federation Forces'
newest mobile suit, the "Gundam,"
climbs aboard, and takes on the Zeon mobile suits,
destroying them.
Having narrowly escaped Side 7,
Amuro and the others, and the near-amateur crew
of the cutting-edge warship White Base,
head for the Federation Forces' HQ on Earth,
"Jaburo."
But Char, relentlessly pursuing them,
targets the moment they enter the atmosphere
and launches his attack.
Jaburo
rows.note: full-width subtitle converted to ASCII; shared by fg03/pr_0a01/pr_0b01

rows.en: After countless fierce battles, the White Base
had at last reached the Federation Forces base "Jaburo,"
but even so,
rows.note: subject White Base moved up to S02022 for English word order; this row keeps the 'but' (de atta ga)

rows.en: the fighting does not end.
Char, who had pursued the White Base there,
succeeds in finding a secret entrance
to Jaburo.
rows.note: 'Jaburo' shifted from 2027 to 2028 and 'succeeds' to 2027 for English order

rows.en: Seizing this chance, the Zeon forces'
"Jaburo Invasion Operation"
is set to begin.
Solomon
The space fortress Solomon.
The pride of the Zeon forces, their forward base in space.
Having retaken Zeon's bases on Earth one after another,
the Earth Federation Forces set their next target:
Solomon.
Taking this very fortress
will be the first step of the Federation's counteroffensive in space.
The White Base, too,
was to be pressed into this battle.
The demon lurking in Solomon...
Against the giant mobile armor "Big Zam,"
a fierce battle begins.
A Baoa Qu
rows.note: full-width subtitle converted to ASCII; shared by several files

rows.en: Universal Century 0079, December 29.
The Earth Federation Forces' space counteroffensive,
"Operation Star One," had entered its final stage,
and from the captured space fortress Solomon,
the Federation's main fleet, led by General Revil,
set out for A Baoa Qu.
But suddenly, a single beam of light streaked across space.
The Principality of Zeon's ultimate weapon,
the colony laser cannon "Solar Ray,"
had blasted a third of the Federation fleet
out of existence.
With General Revil lost to this blow,
the Federation Forces still push ahead with the operation.
Now, the last great battle of the One Year War,
the operation to take A Baoa Qu,
rows.note: source uses half-width dots here; same name

rows.en: is about to begin.
Destined rivals, Amuro and Char.
How will their battle end...?
Universal Century 0079, December 30.
Though he attacks the White Base again and again,
rows.note: 'he' anticipates Char (named in S02067), as the Japanese delays the subject

rows.en: the power of the Gundam piloted by Amuro Ray
leaves Char Aznable with nothing to show for it.
rows.note: Japanese is a noun phrase ending on Char's name; sentence may continue in mission_intro_05

decisions: Narration tense follows the source: past where the Japanese uses ta/teita, narrative present elsewhere.

jionkoukokugun (Principality of Zeon Forces) written as 'Principality of Zeon' in S02001/S02053 for width; jiongun = 'Zeon forces'; rengougun = 'Federation Forces' (or 'Federation' as possessive where the line was long: S02039, S02050, S02055).
Bracketed names keep double quotes ("Nu Gundam", "Gundam", "Jaburo", "Big Zam", "Solar Ray", "Operation Star One").
Small cross-row word shifts where English order demanded it (S01995-96, S02022-24, S02027-28); no rows merged or split.
uncertain: S02030: 'Jaburo Invasion Operation' is a literal rendering of the operation name; no glossary entry. Could be 'invasion of Jaburo' if a canonical name exists.
S02001/S02053: used 'Principality of Zeon' instead of glossary 'Principality of Zeon Forces' to save width; restore if the line fits.
S02024: 'but even so,' is a thin row because the White Base subject moved to S02022; check it reads well on screen.
S02001, S02039, S02052: longer than the 2.4x width guide; need measurement.
